system.description:
Prerequisite: Temporal Stopwatch

As an action, you can choose up to 3 willing creatures within 20 feet of you. For the next minute, the chosen creatures can Dash as a bonus action.

If any of the affected creatures would, make a Dexterity saving throw while they are benefiting from this effect, they can spend their reaction and end this effect, gaining Advantage on that save. A creature can benefit from this Mirage once every 10 minutes.

activities.label: Accelerate
activities.text: Action: up to 3 willing creatures within 20 feet. For 1 minute they can Dash as a bonus action; one making a Dexterity save can spend its reaction to end it and save with advantage. Once every 10 minutes per creature.
